title: 2,4,6-trichloro-cyclohexa-2,5-dienone
content: A continuous-flow process was optimised for the perchlorination of p-cresol to the corresponding 2,4,6-trichloro-cyclohexa-2,5-dienone derivative employing trichloroisocyanuric acid as a green and safer to handle chlorinating agent. The system could furnish 200 grams of pure material within 5 hours of operation (throughput = 40 g h-1).
